title: Street Building Beat
hook: Look for evidence before naming the place.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D neighborhood storybook, friendly streets and buildings, clean isolated subjects; visual identity: Street Building Beat

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: evidence recall -> target -> safe point gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Street Building Beat about facade-to-function evidence: building type, street access, public service, business, transport and outdoor space are inferred from signs/entrances, not from architecture alone.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child looks at door, sign, window, route, and public/private clue before naming what a building or street element does.
